From a letter to the editor of the San Francisco Chronicle , May 20, 2001

Author: Kevin A. Sabet is president of Citizens for a Drug-Free Berkeley and a senior at UC Berkeley. He was a speech writer for former drug-czar Barry McCaffrey.

Excerpt:

THE ROLE OF CANNABIS - SNUFFING OUT MEDICAL MARIJUANA - REAL AGENDA NIPPED IN THE BUD

 

By Ruling Against Doobies As Legal Pain Relievers, The U.S.  Supreme Court Lit Up Debate Over Its No-Exceptions Interpretation Of The Federal Controlled Substance Act In its resounding "no" to California organizations that distribute marijuana - supposedly for medical purposes - the U.S.  Supreme Court reaffirmed Congress' "determination that marijuana has no medical benefits worthy of an exception" to any prohibitions in the Controlled Substances Act.  

The court also rejected medical necessity as a defense to manufacturing and distributing marijuana.  The ruling is in accord with the scientific evidence on marijuana, at least in its smoked form.”

 

Now 24 years later…

When you tell people what they want to hear, they don’t ask the obvious questions.

 

Yesterday, I posted an interview that professional Prohibitionist, Kevin Sabet gave to a Hungarian newspaper closely aligned with Hungary’s Putinist regime.

See Kevin Sabet Praises Hungary’s Zero Tolerance For Cannabis: Public demonstrations for cannabis outlawed”

 

Of course, he did say, “I don't necessarily think people should be imprisoned for years for having a joint, but we need not be encouraging that behavior, which is what legalization or decriminalization can do,"

 

How kind of him! Now consider the other Kevin Sabet, when he is writing for an American conservative audience. He is just opposing health insurance coverage for cannabis.

 

Complete text from Cannabis Copverage Will Only Get More People Hooked.

 

“Should health insurance cover marijuana? Should it cover vodka? Lucky Strikes? Bacon cheeseburgers? Like all those substances, marijuana contains pleasure-giving, mind-altering chemicals that the brain desperately wants more and more of (especially at today’s ultra-high potencies).

 

“It’s not medicine and never has been.”

Oh, really?

See National Institutes of Health (.gov)

https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov

Medicinal Cannabis: History, Pharmacology, And Implications for the Acute Care Setting

by MB Bridgeman · 2017 · Cited by 831 — In the U.S., cannabis was widely utilized as a patent medicine during the 19th and early 20th centuries, described in the United States Pharmacopoeia…

And

The University of Sydney

https://www.sydney.edu.au

History of cannabis - Lambert Initiative for Cannabinoid Therapeutics

Cannabis use began in central Asia/western China around 2800 BC, with medicinal uses in ancient texts. It was introduced to Western medicine in 1841….

And

National Institutes of Health (.gov)

https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov

History of cannabis as a medicine: a review

by AW Zuardi · 2006 · Cited by 1174 — Cannabis as a medicine was used before the Christian era in Asia, mainly in India…

Et al…

 

“Health insurance, which is supposed to keep people healthy, should not cover it. Health insurance shouldn't promote addiction.”

See Marijuana Is In Schedule One. Fentanyl Is In Schedule 2. Think About It.

 

“Medicines are derived from marijuana. Marinol is used to help cancer patients eat.”

Marijuananews note: Well, actually MARinol helped cancer patients eat because people knew that MARinol (as in MARijuana) gave people the munchies. No pharmaceutical company discovered that and no pharmaceutical company discovered it relieved the acute nausea resulting from chemotherapy. Of course, no pharmaceutical company found a way for people vomiting to swallow an expensive pill, so criminals (cancer patients) kept sending the wrong message to children.

See

DEA Moves Marinol To Schedule Three, But Leaves Marijuana in Schedule One. The Magic of Sesame Oil.

 

“Epidiolex is used to treat people with seizure conditions. These are already covered by health insurance.

Marijuananews note: Again, no pharmaceutical company discovered Epidiolex, but they did come up with a clever name for CBD.

 

Marijuananews note:

See “Charlotte Figgi, died at the age of 13. If you use CBD, you should know her name and her story. From the time she was three months old she suffered from Dravet syndrome, a severe form of epilepsy that begins in infancy and often results in seizures every hour of every day. When she was five her parents discovered that CBD greatly reduced the frequency and severity of her seizures, so for the last eight years of her life she and her family had some semblance of normal lives.

 

Dr. Sanjay Gupta said, “She made me realize that it would not just be a medical failing but a moral failing if this medicine was somehow withheld from people.”

See

HOW GW PHARMA WON CBD

 

Marijuananews note: In fact, what Sabet said was actually the direct opposite of the truth for both Marinol and Epidiolex.

 

“But Ozempic is derived from a chemical found in the saliva of the Gila monster. That doesn’t mean letting venomous desert lizards bite you is a legitimate medical treatment. Indeed, the whole regime of state-level “medical” marijuana programs is based on political decisions, not science. Majorities voted to let doctors recommend (not prescribe) marijuana for pretty much anything.

Marijuananews note: That is the result of the way federal law is written. Doctors cannot “prescribe” something that is in Schedule One.

See Marinol Was The First Schedule 2 Drug To Be "Down-Scheduled," Boasts Roxanne On Its New Marinol.com Web Site. Doesn’t That Mean That It Should Never Have Been Schedule 2 Anyway?

 

“We all want people to have access to real treatment, especially people suffering from severe conditions such as chronic pain, significant anxiety or post traumatic stress disorder. The best evidence shows that marijuana do not help with those issues and can even make them worse.

 

“Advocates claim that marijuana helps with chronic pain. A 2017 report from the National Academies of Sciences backed this up.

Yet an alarming study from the American Society of Anesthesiologists shows weed users experience more pain and use more opioids after surgeries. The drug has the opposite effect from what its advocates and industry pushers claim.”

 

Marijuananews note: So what exactly does this “alarming study” actually say?

“The cannabis users had used the drug within 30 days before surgery, while the other patients had never used cannabis. The patients who used cannabis experienced 14% more pain during the first 24 hours after surgery compared to the patients who never used cannabis. Additionally, patients who used cannabis consumed 7% more opioids after surgery, which the authors note was not statistically significant, but is likely clinically relevant.”

 

Marijuananews: Alarming? Maybe he should try some medical cannabis to calm down…

 

“When it comes to mental health issues, the drug can increase anxiety, depression, suicidal ideation and suicide. Adolescents who used the drug have a higher risk of suicide attempts, according to an analysis of survey data by the National Institutes of Health.

A massive study from Denmark linked higher cases of schizophrenia in younger men to heavy cannabis use. “

Marijuananews note: Or the more troubled a young man is, the more cannabis he may consume.

 

“According to federal data, 9% of veterans who died of suicide in 2022 had cannabis use disorder.

Marijuananews note: Or they were suicidal because they could note get medical cannabis from the VA??

See The Wall Street Journal Carries Excellent Story About The Outrageous Medical Abuse of Veterans: But No Mention of Medical Cannabis

And

Veterans Day And Medical Cannabis. Literally Adding Insult To Injury

 

“The argument that it is some undiscovered wonder drug deserving of insurance coverage lacks merit. Nor will normalizing it somehow advance the research around. It’s already been extensively researched. How many more studies could advocates possibly want? The pharmaceutical industry has been trying to make weed a marquee drug for decades. It hasn’t succeeded because the drug's treatment potential does not seem to be that significant.”

Marijuananews note: Or the pharmaceutical companies can’t make something that is better than the natural product???

 

“Raw weed isn’t medicine. Getting the government and insurance companies to suggest otherwise will only get more people hooked, ruin more lives and wreck public health while fattening the wallets of addiction profiteers.”

Marijuananews note: Countries that have legalized medical use of cannabis include Albania, Argentina, Australia, Barbados, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Ecuador, Finland, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Jamaica, Lebanon, Luxembourg, Malawi, Malta, Mexico, the Netherlands, New Zealand, North Macedonia, Norway, Panama, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Rwanda, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, San Marino, Slovenia, South Africa, Spain, Sri Lanka, Switzerland, Thailand, Ukraine, the United Kingdom, Uruguay, Vanuatu, Zambia, and Zimbabwe.

 

Sabet is the president and CEO of Smart Approaches to Marijuana: learnaboutsam.org. He was a drug policy adviser to three presidential administrations and wrote this for InsideSources.com.

 

Sabet’s article was in response to Insurance Coverage Is The Next Logical Step For Medical Cannabis
